lanes.name: Home
lanes.note: Today at a glance. Widgets you can rearrange; each one opens the page behind it.

lanes.name: Log button
lanes.note: The round button on every tab. One tap to log a climb, a weigh-in, a note, or to start a session.

lanes.name: Train
lanes.note: Plans, the exercise library and the weekly schedule. Starting a plan opens the live session.

lanes.name: Live session
lanes.tab: From Train or the Log menu
lanes.note: A running workout or climbing day. It keeps running when you leave the screen, with a pill above the tab bar and a live notification.

lanes.name: Journal
lanes.note: One timeline of climbs, sessions, results and notes, with search and filters.

lanes.name: Progress
lanes.note: How climbing and training are going.

lanes.name: You
lanes.note: Your profile, body, places and settings.

lanes.name: Datasets
lanes.note: Your own lists of climbs, such as a gym circuit or a crag’s problems. Import them from a CSV or a Crux file, search and sort them, and export them again.

lanes.name: Other states
lanes.tab: The same pages with other settings
lanes.note: Light theme, the largest text size, another accent colour, and Home before there is any data.

lanes.name: Launcher shortcuts
lanes.note: Four shortcuts on the app icon jump straight to a page, without opening Home first.

pages.title: Home
pages.desc: The dashboard: today’s plan from your weekly schedule (with Start session and View plan on a plan day), climbs and days this week, latest best, bodyweight, open projects (with the part of the place at places that have several) and recent climbs. Tapping a project or a recent climb opens its log.

pages.title: Home, lower half
pages.desc: Open projects with their goes, and your recent climbs with a link to the Journal.

pages.title: Edit dashboard
pages.desc: Edit mode: drag widgets to move them, resize them or remove them.

pages.title: Add widget
pages.desc: The widget list: Today’s plan, This week, Days on the wall, Latest best, Bodyweight, Weight trend, Sends per week, Sends by style, Recent climbs, Projects, Consistency, Training, Exercise and My gym.

pages.title: Choose what to show
pages.desc: The Training and Exercise widgets ask what to show: a training figure (on plan, sessions, sets, time or new bests) or one exercise.

pages.title: Climbs this week
pages.desc: Every climb of the week, with a week picker and totals for climbs, sends and hardest.

pages.title: Days on the wall
pages.desc: A calendar of the days you climbed, with week, month and year counts and your week streak.

pages.title: Log menu
pages.desc: What did you do? Log climb, Log weight, Start a session, Add a note.

pages.title: Log climb
pages.desc: Where, climb type, grade strip, the day, goes (+ Fell, + Sent), how hard it felt, name, note, photo and video. When a session is running, the climb joins it.

pages.title: Log climb, lower half
pages.desc: Effort, name, note and the photo and video buttons, then Log climb.

pages.title: Where
pages.desc: Pick a saved place, then a facility and area, then a climb from its datasets. Or skip and log without a place.

pages.title: New place
pages.desc: Name a new place and pick its type without leaving Log climb.

pages.title: Pick the day
pages.desc: A calendar for logging a climb on an earlier day.

pages.title: Log weight
pages.desc: The day strip and a ruler for today’s bodyweight sit at the bottom, within reach of your thumb, with the change since your last weigh-in.

pages.title: New note
pages.desc: Write a thought, a niggle or beta, with an optional tag.

pages.title: Where, wall step
pages.desc: After the place, pick the wall or facility. A problem on the wall fills in its grade.

pages.title: Edit log
pages.desc: A logged climb in the same form as Log climb, with Save changes and Delete. Opening a project from Home or Progress lands here when you already logged it today.

pages.title: Type a value
pages.desc: Rulers, wheels and steppers all open a number pad when you tap the value, so you can type it instead.

pages.title: Note
pages.desc: Edit a note: tag, text, pin or delete.

pages.title: New tag
pages.desc: Name a new tag for a note.

pages.title: Week
pages.desc: Your weekly schedule: which plans and climbing days fall on which day. Home’s Today’s plan follows it.

pages.title: Plan a day
pages.desc: Pick any plans for the day, and a climbing day with an optional place.

pages.title: Plans
pages.desc: Your session plans, each with its blocks, exercises and a time estimate.

pages.title: Plan
pages.desc: A plan’s blocks and exercises with their targets and rests. Start session runs it, Edit plan changes it.

pages.title: Edit plan
pages.desc: Name, description, blocks and exercises. Reorder, remove or add exercises and set each one’s targets.

pages.title: New plan
pages.desc: The same editor, empty: name it, add a block and pick exercises.

pages.title: Add an exercise
pages.desc: Pick an exercise from the library to add to a block.

pages.title: Targets
pages.desc: Sets, reps or time, load and rest for one exercise in the plan.

pages.title: Delete plan?
pages.desc: Asks before a plan is deleted. Finished sessions keep their history.

pages.title: Exercises
pages.desc: The exercise library by category, each with its defaults.

pages.title: Edit exercise
pages.desc: Category, how it is measured and its default sets, reps or time, load and rest. Opened with the pencil on an exercise’s page; saving a new exercise lands on its page.

pages.title: Edit interval exercise
pages.desc: An interval exercise sets work, rest, repeats, cycles and the rest between cycles instead of reps.

pages.title: New exercise
pages.desc: The exercise editor, empty.

pages.title: Delete exercise?
pages.desc: Asks before an exercise is deleted, and says how many plans use it.

pages.title: Start a session
pages.desc: Start without a plan (a climbing day or an unplanned workout), or from one of your plans.

pages.title: Live session
pages.desc: The plan as blocks of exercise cards with a table of sets. A rail of segments under the top bar shows each exercise and fills as sets go in; a climbing block sits among the exercises. Tick a set, or change what you did first.

pages.title: A set logged
pages.desc: A finished exercise folds up. A set that beats your best earns the New best star.

pages.title: Rest in the dock
pages.desc: After a set the dock at the bottom counts the rest down with +30 s and Skip, and buzzes at the end.

pages.title: Big timer
pages.desc: Tap the dock for a big countdown with −30 s, +30 s and Skip rest. Make small returns to the dock.

pages.title: Exercise menu
pages.desc: The ⋯ on a card: About this exercise, change its sets, reps and rest, start its timer, skip the rest of it, or take it out.

pages.title: Change this exercise
pages.desc: Sets, reps or time, load and rest for this session. With a plan, an “Also change the plan” switch carries the change over to it; without it, your plan stays as it is.

pages.title: Exercise timer
pages.desc: An interval exercise can start its own timer; each cycle ticks itself off as a set.

pages.title: Timer running
pages.desc: The dock counts the phases of the interval timer, with pause and skip. Tap it for the big view.

pages.title: Add to this session
pages.desc: Log a climb, climb a playlist, add an exercise, or start an interval timer.

pages.title: Add an exercise
pages.desc: Search the library and add an exercise on the spot.

pages.title: Start a timer
pages.desc: A countdown starts with one tap (30 s to 5 min). Or pick Tabata, Repeaters or your own preparation, work, rest, repeats and cycles.

pages.title: Log a climb here
pages.desc: The same Log climb form; the climb is added to the session and the journal.

pages.title: Finish session
pages.desc: Sets done, climbs and sends, how hard it felt and a note. Save it or discard the session.

pages.title: Discard this session?
pages.desc: Asks before a session is thrown away. Climbs you logged in it stay in the journal.

pages.title: Climb from the first screen
pages.desc: Choosing Climb on the first screen opens Log climb for the session at once; once logged, the climb is a block in the session with a Log climb button, and the dock shows Log climb (and Back to sets while you climb in a plan).

pages.title: Session pill
pages.desc: Leave the session with the back arrow and a pill above the tab bar keeps it one tap away.

pages.title: Live notification
pages.desc: While a session runs, a notification shows progress with its next action: Set done, rest controls, interval Pause and Stop, or Log climb. On Android 16 it is a Live Update. A playlist’s notification has Prev, Light and Next.

pages.title: Journal
pages.desc: Everything you did, newest first: climbs by place, sessions, personal records and notes. Filter by All, Climbs, Training, Notes or Places.

pages.title: Filters
pages.desc: When, sends or not, places and note tags.

pages.title: Search
pages.desc: Search climbs, places and notes.

pages.title: Journal, Training
pages.desc: The Training filter shows sessions and personal records only.

pages.title: Session summary
pages.desc: A finished session: duration, sets done, climbs and each exercise’s sets.

pages.title: Edit session
pages.desc: Change the day, start and finish time, how hard it felt and the note.

pages.title: Pick a time
pages.desc: A clock to set when the session started or finished.

pages.title: Delete this session?
pages.desc: Asks before a finished session is deleted.

pages.title: Climbing
pages.desc: Hardest sends per scale, open projects with their place and, where a place has several parts, which part, and +1 go, sends per week and the boulder pyramid.

pages.title: Climbing, lower half
pages.desc: Sends by style and the routes pyramid by grade.

pages.title: Training
pages.desc: Weeks on plan, sessions, time trained and new bests over the last 30 days, and every exercise with its best.

pages.title: Exercise
pages.desc: One page per exercise: a pencil to edit it, its kind, Log a result (and Timer for interval exercises), the personal record, a chart of the best set or the volume, three figures, how it is set up, the plans that use it, and every day it was trained. Reached from Train → Exercises, a plan’s exercise rows, the session ⋯ menu, Progress, You and the Journal.

pages.title: Exercise, volume
pages.desc: The same chart showing volume, with a range from 3 months to all time.

pages.title: Log a result
pages.desc: Pick an exercise and enter what you did to log a result by hand.

pages.title: You
pages.desc: Climber card with days and climbs this year and your hardest sends, the consistency grid, and your personal records.

pages.title: You, menu
pages.desc: The weight tracker and the “More about you” list: Measurements, Circumferences, Notes, Places, Grade converter, Interval timer and Settings.

pages.title: Measurements
pages.desc: Weight with a chart and range, and body stats on a body outline you tap to update.

pages.title: Measurements, lower half
pages.desc: More body stats and the list of weigh-ins.

pages.title: Circumferences
pages.desc: Left and right forearm, bicep and thigh, plus chest and waist, on a body outline.

pages.title: Notes
pages.desc: Your notes with tag filters and pinned notes first.

pages.title: Places
pages.desc: Gyms, crags and boards with their climb counts, filtered by type.

pages.title: Place
pages.desc: A place: climbs logged, walls, open projects, facilities and every problem with its goes.

pages.title: Edit place
pages.desc: Name, kinds of climbing, a Board, Size and Lights row on board facilities, the datasets offered when you log there, grade scales, location and notes.

pages.title: Edit wall
pages.desc: Rename a wall and give it a photo or a map.

pages.title: Grade converter
pages.desc: Pick a system and a grade, and see it in French, YDS, Font, V and more.

pages.title: Interval timer
pages.desc: Pick Tabata, Repeaters, Max hangs or 4×4s, or set your own. Nothing is logged.

pages.title: Interval timer running
pages.desc: The phase’s colour fills the screen with big seconds, and buttons to pause, skip and go back.

pages.title: Settings
pages.desc: Grades per discipline, theme, accent colour, text size and units.

pages.title: Settings, lower half
pages.desc: Timer sounds, rest after a climb, demo mode, backups, crash reports and About.

pages.title: Backups
pages.desc: Choose what to export, import a backup, set automatic backups to a folder, or export climbs and sessions as a spreadsheet.

pages.title: About
pages.desc: Version, licence, source code and open-source libraries.

pages.title: Update a body stat
pages.desc: Tap a stat on the body outline to type or dial in a new value. Circumferences use the same dialog.

pages.title: New place
pages.desc: The place editor, empty: name, kinds of climbing, grade scales, location and notes.

pages.title: Delete place?
pages.desc: Asks before a place is deleted. Every climb and log is kept.

pages.title: Local grades
pages.desc: A place can grade in its own scale: numbers or colour tapes, easiest first, never converted to Font or French.

pages.title: Tape colour
pages.desc: Tap a tape’s swatch to pick its colour from the palette.

pages.title: Map pin
pages.desc: Search an address or move the map so the pin sits on the place. Uses OpenStreetMap, with no account or key.

pages.title: Get ready
pages.desc: A full-screen countdown before the first repeat.

pages.title: Interval timer, on its side
pages.desc: The timer works on its side too, with the big seconds beside the buttons.

pages.title: Backups, lower half
pages.desc: Photos and videos switches, and Import.

pages.title: Import backup
pages.desc: After you pick a backup file, choose what to bring in. Settings start switched off because they replace yours.

pages.title: Already in Crux
pages.desc: When something in the backup is already here, Crux shows both and asks: skip, replace or keep both.

pages.title: Photo attached
pages.desc: A photo from your gallery or the camera is copied into Crux and shown on the log. Tap it to view it.

pages.title: Photo viewer
pages.desc: The photo full screen: pinch to zoom, drag to pan.

pages.title: Video player
pages.desc: A climb’s video plays full screen. Videos are copied into Crux and are included in backups unless you switch them off.

pages.title: Interval exercise
pages.desc: An interval exercise’s page has a Timer button beside Log a result, which opens the interval timer set up as the exercise is.

pages.title: Journal, Places
pages.desc: The fifth Journal tab lists your places with New place. A place opens its page; New place opens the place editor.

pages.title: My gym widget
pages.desc: The My gym widget shows your favourite place, with Log here to log a climb there and Open for its place page.

pages.title: App icon shortcuts
pages.desc: Long-press the Crux icon: Log a climb, Session (the running session, or the Start a session sheet), Log your weight and Interval timer.

pages.title: Board
pages.desc: Say which board a facility is: Kilter, MoonBoard (each year) or a custom board.

pages.title: Board size
pages.desc: Kilter boards ask for a size; the Homewall also asks for Full ride or Mainline.

pages.title: Log climb on a board
pages.desc: When the place is a board, Log climb gets an Angle chip beside Photo and Video, and the Where card names the board.

pages.title: Board angle
pages.desc: Dial the board’s angle, or pick a common one. It is saved as the first line of the note.

pages.title: Datasets
pages.desc: Your lists of climbs in two tabs, Datasets and Playlists. Each dataset shows its board, climb count and grade scale; board catalogues you import get a section of their own.

pages.title: New dataset or import
pages.desc: The + menu: start an empty dataset or a playlist, or import a CSV, a Crux dataset or playlist file, or a Boardsesh board snapshot.

pages.title: New dataset
pages.desc: Name it and, if it belongs to a board, pick the board; the grade scales are optional. The same sheet edits a dataset’s details.

pages.title: Dataset
pages.desc: One dataset: search by name, setter or note, sort by grade, name or newest, and tap a climb to edit it. Add climb adds another.

pages.title: Dataset options
pages.desc: Edit details, Import climbs, Export or Delete dataset.

pages.title: Export format
pages.desc: CSV opens in any spreadsheet; a Crux dataset file keeps the board and grades and imports straight back.

pages.title: Delete dataset?
pages.desc: Asks before a dataset and its climbs are deleted.

pages.title: Edit climb
pages.desc: Name, type, grade, setter and note for one climb, with Save, Log this climb, Playlist (add it to one) and Delete climb.

pages.title: Add climb
pages.desc: The same sheet, empty, to add a climb to the dataset.

pages.title: Delete this climb?
pages.desc: Asks before a climb that has a note is deleted, since the note goes with it.

pages.title: Can’t import this file
pages.desc: A file Crux cannot read as climbs shows what is wrong, such as a missing name column.

pages.title: Import preview
pages.desc: After you pick a file: how many climbs were found, what to do with climbs already there (skip, replace or keep both) and a preview.

pages.title: Playlists
pages.desc: The Playlists tab lists your playlists: an ordered set of climbs from your datasets to work through in a session.

pages.title: New playlist
pages.desc: Name a playlist and add a note. The same sheet renames it.

pages.title: Playlist
pages.desc: The climbs of a playlist in order: hold and drag to move one. Climb this playlist starts them in a session.

pages.title: Playlist options
pages.desc: Rename, Duplicate, Export (a Crux playlist file to share) or Delete playlist.

pages.title: Rename playlist
pages.desc: Change a playlist’s name and note.

pages.title: Delete playlist?
pages.desc: Asks before a playlist is deleted. The climbs stay in their datasets and logged climbs are never touched.

pages.title: Select climbs
pages.desc: Hold a climb to select it, then pick more. Add to playlist adds them all.

pages.title: Add to a playlist
pages.desc: Pick a playlist, or make a new one, to add the selected climbs to.

pages.title: Log this climb
pages.desc: Log climb opens with the dataset climb’s name, grade and setter filled in, linked to it.

pages.title: Datasets for a facility
pages.desc: Tick the datasets to offer when you log a climb at this facility, or make a new dataset for its board.

pages.title: Where, climb step
pages.desc: After the place and area, a Climb step lists the climbs of the datasets linked there, with search, your playlists and the board catalogue as chips. New climb types its name in the form.

pages.title: Climb a playlist
pages.desc: Pick one of your playlists to work through in this session.

pages.title: Playlist in the session
pages.desc: A card steps through the playlist: the climb, its grade and setter, a hold diagram for board climbs, Prev and Next, and + Fell and + Sent that log goes on it. With a paired board, a Light button lights the climb on the wall.

pages.title: Import a board catalogue
pages.desc: Pick a Boardsesh snapshot (a .db or .db.gz) for Kilter or MoonBoard. The sheet reads it, asks for your board’s size (and holds on a Homewall), shows progress while it reads, then says what it kept.

pages.title: Imported
pages.desc: A summary of what was added and what was skipped.

pages.title: Imported playlist
pages.desc: After a Crux playlist file is imported: how many of its climbs were found in your datasets, with Open to go to the playlist.

pages.title: Catalogue imported
pages.desc: When the import finishes, the sheet says how many climbs were kept, with Open to browse them. The catalogue stays on this phone, apart from your data: it is not in backups or exports.

pages.title: Datasets with a catalogue
pages.desc: Imported catalogues get a Board catalogues section above your datasets, each read-only with its board, size and climb count.

pages.title: Board catalogue
pages.desc: The climbs of a board catalogue, read-only: search by name or setter, pick the angle (30°, 40°, 45°) and sort by popularity, grade or name, or show benchmarks only.

pages.title: Delete catalogue?
pages.desc: Its climbs leave Crux and your playlists lose them until you import it again. Climbs you logged from it stay.

pages.title: Catalogue climb
pages.desc: One catalogue climb, led by the board diagram with a legend (start, hand, finish, foot): its setter, the angle you are on, its grade at each angle with the ascents, then Log this climb or Playlist. Tap the diagram to see the whole board. Once a board is paired, a Light button shows the climb’s holds on the wall.

pages.title: Where, catalogue chip
pages.desc: On a board facility the Climb step has a chip for the board’s catalogue; it lists the catalogue’s climbs to log.

pages.title: Full board
pages.desc: Tap any hold diagram to see the climb on the whole board, with every hold of the board as a faint dot and the climb’s holds ringed in their role’s colour.

pages.title: Log a catalogue climb
pages.desc: Log climb opens with the catalogue climb’s hold diagram and name in the linked name row, and a hint of what the board says its grade is. A Light button sits under the linked name once a board is paired.

pages.title: Playlist with a board climb
pages.desc: A playlist card for a catalogue climb draws its holds on the board. Tap the diagram for the full board. With a paired board there is a Light button too.

pages.title: Edit log with holds
pages.desc: A climb logged from a catalogue keeps its holds: the log shows a Holds card with the diagram, the setter and the board’s grade.

pages.title: Light theme
pages.desc: Settings has Dark (the default), Light or System. Everything follows, accent colours included.

pages.title: Largest text
pages.desc: Text size goes up to Largest, on top of the phone’s own font size.

pages.title: Accent colour
pages.desc: Seven accent colours; the amber for goes and the green for sends stay the same in every accent.

pages.title: Home with no data
pages.desc: Before there is any data, every widget explains what will appear and how to add the first entry.

pages.title: Board lights
pages.desc: Pair a Kilter or MoonBoard through Android’s companion picker (Crux asks for Nearby devices, never your location). Once paired the sheet offers Test lights, Check a hold on a MoonBoard, Lights off and Forget. Shown here unpaired, as on a phone without the board nearby.

pages.title: What are you doing first?
pages.desc: A session without a plan opens here: Climb (log climbs as you go), Climb a playlist, An exercise from your library, or A timer. Each becomes a block, in the order you add them.

pages.title: Select notes
pages.desc: Hold a note to pick it, then tap more; the top bar counts how many are selected and has a bin that deletes the picked notes, with Undo.

pages.title: Select entries
pages.desc: Hold a journal entry to pick it, then tap more; the top bar counts how many are selected and has a bin that deletes the picked entries, with Undo.

pages.title: Choose a climb
pages.desc: Under Name: your open projects at the place, and a chip for each playlist. Picking one fills the form to add goes to it.

pages.title: Filters
pages.desc: Drag the two ends of the grade slider to show only a range of grades, and hide the climbs you have sent. The list updates as you go.

edges: Board row on a board facility

ignore.CruxSheet: The frame every bottom sheet is drawn in, not a sheet of its own
ignore.ActionSheet: The frame of the menu sheets, which are on the map under their own names
